Name: SH's Domestic Animals (and Adoptable Spouse's Pets)
Author: plurffle
Description:
[b][font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b][size=6][img]https://imgur.com/ZcQMnRB.png[/img][/size][/color][/font][/b]
This was mod was once a little bonus to my previous mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]Wild Animals[/url], but I have now decided to separate them into two different mods. You are guaranteed to see the animals as long as you have access to the areas that they spawn in. They tend to wander so you may or may not lose sight of some of them, especially if they wander behind the buildings and bushes.

These animals don't really do much of anything and are more of just ambient for your valley that occasionally makes noises and interact with a little! Some animals may not be very fond of the player [i]especially[/i] in the early game... And who knows? You might be able to adopt some of these critters if you marry certain spouses. 

Below is the list of animals currently included in the mod:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]A brown cat for Willy[/*]
[*]A black cat slime that stay in the witch's hut/swamp[/*]
[*]A little green dragon for the wizard[/*]
[*]Charlie the Chicken[/*]
[*]David, Abigail's guinea pig + changes his cage depending if he's inside or outside of it[/*]
[*]Dusty, Alex' dog + changes his box into a dog house (this will automatically be disabled if SVE or Free Dusty mod is installed to avoid conflicts)[/*]
[*]Emily's parrot companion[/*]
[*]Rabbits for Leah[/*]
[*]Rooster + more of Marnie's barn animals[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Shadow pups in the sewers[/*]
[*]Stray cats and kittens (if you want more cats in Pelican Town, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7998]Kitty Cats[/url] mod! <3 )[/*]
[*]Stray dogs[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=6][img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2088][b]Link to frequently asked questions and known issues section[/b][/url]

[font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b][size=6][b][img]https://imgur.com/lT7uwQV.png[/img][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][b]Concerned Ape[/b] for his marvelous game that I spent many, many hours on. Stardew Valley will always be placed in a special place in my heart and I will never regret owning the game (thanks again to my friend who bought it for me a couple of years ago!) His pixel art and the color palette are undeniably beautiful and I tried to have my animals match the aesthetic. <3[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for their modding API "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿" and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. As well as [b]PeacefulEnd[/b] for their modding framework [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url]﻿. These mods allowed me to create this mod. I've always wanted to have more animals in the world of Stardew Valley because I just love animals. <3[/*]
[*][b]Obamoose[/b] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7998]Kitty Cats[/url] mod! The moment I saw that mod I thought to myself "Wait a minute... That can be done now?" and it spurred on this drive to work on my Wild Animals mod (the Domestic Animals mod was once a part of this one as a little bonus). Whenever I felt stuck in the little coding process, I did comparisons with their adorable mod's coding structure as an example (and of course [b]PeacefulEnd[/b]'s Custom Companions in-depth wiki was a great help and easy to understand). The Kitty Cats mod was a great visual for me while I was creating this mod (and I love cats, so this mod is definitely staying in my game) <3[/*]
[/list]


[center]I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public![/center]
